title: EDL cut with retimed transcripts, speed and grade
what_it_does: apply-edl joins ranges from several sources (different frame rates and levels), moves transcripts onto the cut, supports slow motion, speed, grade and LUT per range, and converts HDR phone footage to SDR.
when_to_use: Multi-take edits where captions must follow the cut.
why: Too large to carry whole; the CUT.md rules and the retimed-transcript idea are what to reimplement. Herk's EDL scripts cover the basic case.
